title: Plushbound Legends Whole-Game Placeholder Completeness Matrix
purpose: Audit namespace separation and verify that every planned Plushtopia region has placeholder capacity across all required asset families before binary placeholder packs are finalized.

technicalBaseline.finalArtTarget: original Plushbound MV-cover/Trinity-inspired JRPG visual pass
technicalBaseline.replacementRule: Preserve stable logical IDs, dimensions, footprints, frame semantics and bindings during final-art replacement.

hardRules: Guardian IDs may never resolve through enemy or boss namespaces.
Rare Guardian appearances remain Guardian habitat assets and never hostile encounter assets.
Chris Bourn, Penney Nguyen, Lily and Ethan use reserved canon identities and may not be generated from ambient NPC recipe IDs.
Shared assets use shared/global ownership; regional variants use explicit region ownership.
Story-state visual variants retain the same collision and interaction footprint unless explicitly versioned as a new logical asset.
Child NPC assets remain age-appropriate and separate from adult-only wardrobe or occupation variants.
Placeholder IDs survive the later final-art pass unchanged.
namespaceAudit.knownContentRiskToKeepSeparated: Verdancia legacy encounter data may mix Guardian names with hostile encounter families; asset namespaces explicitly prohibit that mixture and gameplay/content cleanup is deferred to the later game-development phase.

canonCoverage.policy: Closed-canon Plushbound identities; unique asset sets only; never ambient templates.

remainingAssetOnlyBatches.goal: Define concrete placeholder file generation batches and canonical filenames for every manifest family.
Generate engine-compatible stand-in binary assets in manageable packs without creating final artwork.
Validate dimensions, alpha, frame grids, naming, file presence and manifest references.
Freeze the complete placeholder asset library as the handoff baseline before any gameplay-development phase begins.

phaseBoundary.note: Do not implement maps, quests, encounters, economy behavior, combat behavior or runtime gameplay as part of these asset-only batches.
